body: The Brazilian winger tore the anterior cruciate ligament and outer meniscus in his right knee against Getafe on March 3. After undergoing surgery a week later, he returned to running on the pitch on September 3 and has now progressed to ball work as part of his rehabilitation.
With an estimated recovery timeline of ten to twelve months, the club aims to have the forward back in full training under José Mourinho in time for the business end of the season.

Avec une indisponibilité estimée entre dix mois et un an, le club espère réintégrer l'attaquant au groupe dirigé par José Mourinho pour le sprint final de la saison.
